goals.condition: /goal Build a native Windows 11 desktop AI coding assistant inspired by Claude Code, designed to be a premium developer environment with a beautiful Material You + Fluent Design interface. The app should feel like a first-party Windows 11 application: fast, polished, compact, modern, and highly customizable. # Design System Create a unique visual identity based around: - Lime accent theme (#84CC16 or similar) - Material You dynamic color system - Windows 11 Fluent Design principles - Mica backdrop - Acrylic effects where suitable - Rounded corners (12–16px) - Soft shadows - Smooth animations - Compact spacing with small margins (8–12px) - Dense but comfortable layouts - Minimal wasted space - Modern IDE aesthetic Support: - Dark mode - Light mode - System theme sync - High contrast accessibility Typography: - Segoe UI Variable - Clear hierarchy - Compact sizing - Excellent readability UI details: - Floating cards - Material You style controls - Smooth hover states - Ripple effects - Animated transitions - Skeleton loading states - Beautiful empty states - Consistent icon system # Core Application Create an AI-powered coding environment similar to Claude Code, but optimized for Windows. The application should include: ## AI Assistant A project-aware AI assistant that can: - Understand entire codebases - Read project files - Create files - Modify files - Rename files - Refactor code - Explain code - Fix bugs - Generate documentation - Write tests - Review code - Analyze repositories - Suggest improvements - Perform multi-step coding tasks AI changes must: - Show a diff preview before applying - Require approval for destructive actions - Support undo/rollback Include: - Chat history per project - Conversation management - Context management - Workspace memory - Streaming responses # AI Provider System Create a modular AI provider architecture. Support: - NVIDIA NIM - OpenAI - Anthropic - Google Gemini - OpenRouter - Ollama - Local models Users should be able to switch providers easily. ## NVIDIA NIM Setup During first launch, include a setup wizard. The setup flow: 1. Welcome screen 2. AI provider selection 3. Provider configuration 4. Connection test 5. Complete setup For NVIDIA NIM: - Provide NVIDIA NIM as a first-class provider option - Ask the user to enter their NVIDIA NIM API key - Provide a secure API key input field - Validate the API key with a test request - Allow model selection after successful connection - Enable streaming responses - Save credentials securely using Windows Credential Manager - Never store API keys as plain text Settings should allow users to: - Add providers - Remove providers - Change API keys - Test connections - Change models - Set the default provider - Configure AI behaviour - Configure context limits # Code Editor Include a professional code editor similar to VS Code: Features: - Syntax highlighting - Multiple cursors - Code folding - Minimap - Tabs - Split editors - Breadcrumb navigation - Symbol outline - Autocomplete - Diagnostics - Error highlighting - Formatting - Format on save - Search and replace - Regex search - Workspace search - Git decorations # Terminal Create a powerful integrated terminal: Support: - PowerShell - Command Prompt - Git Bash - WSL Features: - Multiple terminals - Terminal tabs - Split panes - ANSI colours - Streaming output - Search output - Command history - Custom profiles - Drag-and-drop files - AI-generated commands Commands generated by AI must require user approval before execution. # File Explorer Create a fast project explorer: Features: - File tree - Folder navigation - Git status icons - File previews - Context menus - Drag and drop - Rename/create/delete files - Workspace switching Support extremely large projects with background indexing. # Git Integration Built-in Git tools: - Repository status - Commit creation - Branch switching - Commit history - Diff viewer - Git blame - Merge conflict viewer # Productivity Features Include: - Command palette (Ctrl + Shift + P) - Keyboard shortcuts - Global search - Multiple workspace tabs - Settings application - Notifications - Auto updates - Crash recovery - Session restore # Plugin System Create an extension system allowing: - Custom AI providers - Themes - Editor extensions - Terminal extensions - Workflow automation Plugins must run safely with permissions. # Security Implement: - Secure API key storage - Permission prompts - Command execution approval - File modification approval - Safe plugin isolation - Secure local storage # Performance Requirements The app must: - Launch in under 2 seconds - Maintain smooth 60 FPS animations - Handle repositories with 100,000+ files - Use background indexing - Avoid UI freezing - Efficiently manage memory # Technology Requirements Preferred stack: - C# - WinUI 3 - Windows App SDK - MVVM architecture - Dependency Injection - Async programming - Clean architecture - Modular codebase - Unit tests - Comprehensive logging Avoid Electron if possible. Prioritize a true native Windows experience. # Final Vision Create the ultimate Windows 11 AI development environment. It should combine: - Claude Code's powerful AI workflow - VS Code's developer experience - Windows 11's native design language - Material You customization - A premium lime-themed interface The final product should feel like a professional tool made by Microsoft for modern AI-assisted developers.
